findings.function: 68 external calls and 28 custom-error reverts across connectToVaultHub, reconnectToVaultHub, voluntaryDisconnect, abandonDashboard, setFeeRate, mint*/burn*, fund, withdraw, rebalance*, pause/resume deposits, triggerValidatorWithdrawals, ... (role checks)
findings.decompiled: _16 = mem[64] / mem[mem[64]] = 0xf2fde38b.. / mem[_16 + 4] = 0 / call address(_15).mem[_16 len 4] with: args 0  |  _12 = mem[64] / mem[mem[64]] = 0xe2517d3f.. / revert with mem[_12 len 4], caller, 0
findings.issue: The selector is stored with mem[mem[64]] and read back as mem[_16 len 4] with _16 = mem[64], and the two spellings of the same address are not identified: the arguments (written through _16 + 4) are decoded but the function or error name is printed as a memory slice although the constant is on the line above. 96 such lines here; the same display is frequent in other via-IR texts (c00085: 303, c00516: 135).
findings.rule: After 'x = mem[64]' with no store to slot 64 before a use, rewrite mem[mem[64] + k] as mem[x + k] everywhere (stores and loads); then mem[x len 4] after 'mem[x] = C' is C >> 224 and the call or revert prints with that selector.

findings.source: Confirmations.sol:130-160 for (i < numberOfRoles) over confirmingRoles() = [DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, NODE_OPERATOR_MANAGER_ROLE]; AccessControl hasRole
findings.issue: Dead scratch traffic is printed: a save/restore of mem[0] around a constant, a zeroing repeated, keccak scratch written twice; the Panic(50) checks inside the constant-bound loops are implied by idx < 2 = mem[_17].
findings.rule: Drop stores overwritten before any read and a restore of a word to its saved value; fold mem[_17] to the constant 2 stored there and drop 'idx >= 2' under 'idx < 2'.

notes: 97 ABI functions, most of them role-gated one-line wrappers or getters, all read; the longer ones (proveUnknownValidatorsToPDG, unguaranteedDepositToBeaconChain, triggerValidatorWithdrawals, minimalReserve, the confirmation-gated setters) read by structure. Source loops: grantRoles (813), revokeRoles (1541), the three Confirmations loops (bound folded to the constant 2, in setConfirmExpiry 1085/1122/1134 and in the three other confirmation-gated functions), unguaranteedDepositToBeaconChain x2 (5788, 6037), _proveUnknownValidatorsToPDG (2432); all shown as while. getRoleMembers' storage copy (119) and the returned-struct decoders (2383) are implicit. P18: 35 range checks of decoded return words printed as 'require not mem[a len 20] << 96' (a uint96 check: the first 20 bytes are zero) and int104/uint48 checks on memory slices. 109 reverts bubble return data with 'revert with memory from _n len return_data.size' (correct). Storage: the ERC-7201 namespaced AccessControl and Confirmations storages print as stor[sha3(caller, 0xad32..)] and storE4CA[concat(call.data[0 len calldata.size])][role].
summary: Faithful and mostly readable (calls, role checks, confirmation logic and loops match), but 96 calls and reverts print their selector as a memory slice although the constant is stored on the previous line, because mem[mem[64]] and mem[x] with x = mem[64] are not identified.
